description: Defines the class 'radio_uhd_rx_stream' which implements a UHD receive stream gateway receiver, including methods for starting, stopping, and receiving data, along with associated configuration structures and internal state.

classes.name: radio_uhd_rx_stream
classes.description: Implements a UHD receive stream gateway receiver with methods for control and data reception, and internal state management.

methods.name: receive_block
methods.description: Receives a single block of baseband samples, filling buffers and metadata, returning success status.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the UHD receive stream at a specified start time.

methods.name: get_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum packet size for the buffer.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives data into provided buffer, as part of the baseband_gateway_receiver interface.
